title: Skill report
description: A skill's result is a report: a claim about what was done, tied to the authorization that warranted it (SK-12). Unknown fields are rejected.

authorization_id.description: The authorization this invocation ran under; a report without one is REFUSED.

skill.description: The skill that produced the report; must equal the skill on the cited authorization.

mode.description: The mode the invocation ran in; must equal the mode on the cited authorization.

stage.description: The stage worked; must equal the stage on the cited authorization (SK-11).

outcome.description: COMPLETE: the skill's procedure finished. BLOCKED: it stopped at a gate with findings. REFUSED: no valid authorization, or an out-of-warrant act was requested.

scope_observed.description: Paths this invocation read (read-only skills) or mutated (mutating skills). Every entry must match a pattern in the cited authorization's scope (SK-04).

id.description: Stable finding id, e.g. STAGE-F-NNN; remediation cites these (SK-05).

claim.description: What is wrong, naming the file and the evidence on disk.

findings.description: Findings raised; the reviewer's primary output, never a patch.

verdict.description: The stage's own verdict token, when the stage defines one.

summary.description: What was done, what was run, what remains; claims here are reviewable.
